sentences.text: Shahid Kapoor -LRB- -LSB- ʃaːɦɪd̪ kəˈpuːr -RSB- ; born 25 February 1981 -RRB- , also known as Shahid Khattar , is an Indian actor who appears in Hindi films .	Hindi films	Bollywood
The son of actors Pankaj Kapur and Neelima Azeem , Kapoor was born in New Delhi .	Pankaj Kapur	Pankaj Kapur	Neelima Azeem	Neelima Azeem
His parents separated when he was three , and he continued living with his mother .
They moved to Mumbai when he was 10 , where he joined Shiamak Davar 's dance academy .	Shiamak Davar	Shiamak Davar
Kapoor appeared as a background dancer in a few films of the 1990s , and was later featured in music videos and television commercials .

Kapoor made his film debut in 2003 with a leading role in the romantic comedy Ishq Vishk , a sleeper hit for which he won a Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut .	Ishq Vishk	Ishq Vishk	sleeper hit	sleeper hit	Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut	Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut
He followed it with roles in several commercial failures before starring in Sooraj Barjatya 's top-grossing family drama Vivah -LRB- 2006 -RRB- .	Sooraj Barjatya	Sooraj Barjatya	Vivah	Vivah

Kapoor earned nominations for the Filmfare Award for Best Actor for portraying a troubled businessman in Imtiaz Ali 's romantic comedy Jab We Met -LRB- 2007 -RRB- and twin brothers in Vishal Bhardwaj 's caper thriller Kaminey -LRB- 2009 -RRB- .	Filmfare Award for Best Actor	Filmfare Award for Best Actor	Imtiaz Ali	Imtiaz Ali (director)	Jab We Met	Jab We Met	Vishal Bhardwaj	Vishal Bhardwaj	Kaminey	Kaminey
After appearing in another series of box office flops , he starred in the action film R. .
In 2014 , Kapoor portrayed the Hamlet character in Bhardwaj 's acclaimed drama Haider , for which he won the Best Actor award at Filmfare .	Hamlet	Prince Hamlet	Haider	Haider (film)

Two years later , he played a drug abusing singer in the crime drama Udta Punjab , which won him the Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actor .	Udta Punjab	Udta Punjab	Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actor	Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actor
Cited in the media as one of the most attractive Indian celebrities , Kapoor maintains his popularity despite a fluctuating career trajectory .
Initially recognised for portraying romantic roles , Kapoor has since taken on parts in action films and thrillers .
He is the recipient of several awards , including three Filmfare Awards .	several awards	List of awards and nominations received by Shahid Kapoor	Filmfare Awards	Filmfare Awards

In addition to acting , Kapoor supports charities , hosts award ceremonies , and has featured as a talent judge on the dance reality show Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa Reloaded -LRB- 2015 -RRB- .	Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa Reloaded	Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa
Following a romantic relationship with the actress Kareena Kapoor , he married Mira Rajput , a student from New Delhi , with whom he has a daughter .	Kareena Kapoor	Kareena Kapoor
